_doc: Per-character sheet specifications, taken from direction/pbl-ramayana-arc7-character-briefs.md with direction/design-decisions.json applied. tools/sheet_prompts.js assembles prompts from this; nothing is written by hand at generation time.
_authority: Creative proposals. Once a sheet is approved by a named person, the APPROVED SHEET governs every frame and this file has done its job.

_universal.mandatory_line: uncut draped handloom - no stitched garment.
world: Cloth is woven, cut from the loom, and draped: antariya at the waist, uttariya over the shoulder. Never tailored, never buttoned.

Ornament from the relief vocabulary - Bharhut, Sanchi, Amaravati: heavy kundala earrings that pull the lobe, flat collars and torques, armlets above the bicep, bangles. Gold that gleams, never glitters. No faceted gems.
Faces from the real range of the subcontinent. Nose bridges, eye shapes, jaws and cheeks that vary. Pores, oil sheen, sun on skin that has lived outdoors, age in the neck and hands.
Bodies are real. No gym physiques. Barefoot on stone.
Never sharpen features to read noble or broaden them to read lowly.
_universal.in_world_light: the hall's light: pierced lattice from frame-left, one brass lamp. Post-and-lintel timber and lime plaster.

views.shot: front view, full figure and head-and-shoulders, neutral standing, even light
three-quarter view, the angle most shots use
in-world frame, the character in the hall's light

_universal.anchor_rule: The FRONT view is the anchor. Three-quarter, profile and in-world are conditioned on the anchor image, never on another generated view. A variation of a variation is a cousin.

characters.why_first: The still sage seated is reused or cropped in fourteen shots across four films. M1's checkpoint depends on him. Design him for stillness first.
characters.subject: an ascetic sage in his sixties, of the line of Kusika
characters.build: lean and physically hard - the shoulders of a man who once trained
characters.hair: matted and piled high in a jata, ash-grey beard
characters.complexion: deep warm brown, sun-weathered, ash on the skin
characters.dress: ochre cloth draped at the waist, a single upper cloth, bare torso otherwise
characters.ornament: a worn string of rudraksha, never displayed. No other ornament.
characters.props: a plain dark dense-wood staff, shoulder-height, worn pale at the grip, blunt and splayed at the base from years on stone. No carving, no finial.
characters.the_one_thing: his eyes REST on what they look at. They do not search.
expressions: seated, composed, unreadable - the still sage
about to speak, a smallest intake of breath

distinct_from.how: matted, ash-grey, lean, sun-dark, ochre - against combed, white, softer, undyed white

characters.never_note: He is a man with a problem, not a threat.

characters.subject: the king of Ayodhya, old - Rama is the son of his old age
characters.build: a broad frame gone soft, a man long a king who has not fought in years. Age in the hands and neck, not only the face.
characters.hair: long, oiled, silver-white, bound. A full grey-white beard, trimmed.
characters.dress: a near-white antariya; a deep red uttariya with a thin woven gold border
characters.ornament: kundala, a flat collar, armlets, bangles, one ring - relief vocabulary
characters.headdress: a wound relief-period royal turban with a crest ornament, in the Bharhut and Sanchi vocabulary
characters.headdress_fallback: a low mukuta - a band rising to a modest crest - if candidates read as a later regional turban
characters.the_one_thing: a face that has smiled a great deal and isn't smiling now. Heavy-lidded, deep-set eyes.
expressions: shock - the moment the request lands
never: a hand clutched to the chest

characters.subject: the family priest of the Raghus, in his seventies, older than the king
characters.build: upright, contained, sits lower than everyone and is listened to by all of them
characters.hair: white, combed, tied at the crown. A white beard cut short. Clean where Vishvamitra is matted.
characters.complexion: warm mid-brown, aged, softer than the sage's
characters.dress: undyed white, draped, one shoulder bare. The sacred thread across the chest.
characters.ornament: one plain ring and the thread. Nothing else.
characters.the_one_thing: when he finally stands, the whole room registers it.
expressions: uttering the mantras at the blessing rite

distinct_from.how: combed white and undyed white, softer - against matted ash-grey and ochre

characters.subject: a boy of fifteen - not yet sixteen by his father's statement
characters.build: slight, not yet filled out. A boy, not a youth, and never a man's body in a boy's role.
characters.hair: long, with the boy's side-locks - kakapakshadhara - clearly visible from every angle INCLUDING FROM BEHIND
characters.complexion_declaration: OURS, from the syama tradition. Never presented as what the text says.
characters.dress: plain undyed cloth, shorter at the knee for walking. A small quiver at the back. Bare feet.
characters.props: a recurved bow of wood and horn, UNSTRUNG, carried - never drawn
characters.the_one_thing: open, unguarded, a boy's face. Neither sweet nor stern.
expressions: plain, a boy - the first face reveal
looking back once, then facing forward
characters.from_behind_matters: In seven of his M7 shots we see his back. The side-locks and the bow must identify him from behind.

distinct_from.how: quicker and slighter; side-locks worn higher; SAME complexion range

characters.subject: Sumitra's son, a year or so younger than Rama - it shows in the jaw, not the height
characters.build: slightly sturdier than Rama. Where Rama is quick, he is planted.
characters.hair: long, side-locks too, worn differently enough to tell them apart from behind - tied lower, or fuller
characters.complexion: the same range as Rama - deep brown
characters.complexion_declaration: The same range as Rama. He is told apart by BUILD AND HAIR ONLY. He is never lighter than Rama.
characters.dress: plain uncut cloth like his brother's. Bare feet.
characters.props: his own bow, unstrung; an archer's finger guard
characters.the_one_thing: the face of someone who has already decided.
expressions: a mouth that sets rather than softens

distinct_from.how: BUILD AND HAIR ONLY - sturdier, planted, rounder face, heavier brow, side-locks tied lower or fuller. NOT by complexion.

never: a heroic beat of his own

characters.subject: the queen mother - HANDS ONLY, her face is never shown
characters.build: hands of a woman who has raised a son to fifteen - not young hands, not ornamental hands
characters.dress: a draped upper cloth at the wrist, fine, undyed
characters.ornament: bangles, relief vocabulary, worn not displayed
characters.the_one_thing: she isn't these films' subject, and withholding her is what makes her moments land.
expressions: hands beside the father's at the blessing rite
a hand releasing the edge of her son's draped upper cloth
plates_only: a hand at the edge of draped cloth
